items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I think Palletti was at Warren Easton. He was the head of the music there. ... I didn't study under him.

ctx.x: Did they have any teachers in high school? Any music teachers that you remember?
I think Palletti was at Warren Easton. He was the head of the music there.
Is that the same guy who used to be out at Spanish Fort?
